attributes.description: Reliance Infrastructure Ltd. is one of the largest infrastructure companies engaged in developing infrastructure projects through various Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) in several sectors such as power, roads, metro rail and airport in the infrastructure space and the defence sector. The Co. is also a leading utility Company having a presence across the value chain of power businesses i.e. generation, transmission, distribution and power trading. [1]
